comment: The panel prints no words at all: every control is marked with a picture, so the lines here carry no labels. The gate length knob is scaled by timerLength (SEQEuclid.cpp:312-318), and timerLength is recomputed only in the branch taken when the clock input is EMPTY (line 230). With a cable in the clock input the gate length therefore divides the tempo the BPM knob last produced while that jack was empty, or 120 BPM if the cable was already there when the patch loaded; it does not follow the external clock. Each of the four channels has its own random generator seeded with the same constant, 738 (SEQEuclid.cpp:106 in Bank::Reset), and the generator is only drawn from when a channel's probability is below 100%, so identical channel settings drop identical beats. Fill at or above length bypasses the Euclidean table and plays every step (line 125 and its else). The trigger outputs are high for a single sample, so a downstream module that reads triggers at audio rate will see them and a display may not.
